latest_release.name: v20.0.49
latest_release.body:
###    🚀 Features

- **adapter**: Report 1h cache writes in JSON model breakdowns  -  by @ryoppippi and **XixianWasTaken** in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2059 [<samp>(c17c5)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/c17c591d)
- **cline**: Add extension and CLI usage adapter  -  by @ryoppippi and **Rushikesh Gaikwad** in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/1977 [<samp>(35411)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/35411151)

###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- **all**:
  - Count only in-window Claude usage in unified session reports  -  by @ryoppippi in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2052 [<samp>(5f310)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/5f31039d)
- **antigravity**:
  - Deduplicate unkeyed mirror usage via step index fallback  -  by **zhibisora** in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2027 [<samp>(00fea)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/00fead09)
- **claude**:
  - Show model breakdowns for session --id  -  by @ryoppippi and **fdarian** in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2057 [<samp>(de439)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/de439528)
  - Keep the cache TTL split when deduping equal copies  -  by @ryoppippi in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2060 [<samp>(e39ed)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/e39ed835)
- **codex**:
  - Guard truncated type fields from panicking the parser  -  by @ryoppippi in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2034 [<samp>(4fb1c)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/4fb1c0d7)
  - Count spawned subagent requests stamped at the fork instant  -  by @ryoppippi in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2051 [<samp>(e4f0e)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/e4f0ea9e)
- **nix**:
  - Make `nix flake show` work again on nixpkgs 26.11  -  by @ryoppippi in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2019 [<samp>(546ae)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/546ae513)
- **opencode**:
  - Exclude Claude Agent turns by default in focused reports  -  by @ryoppippi and **igorovh** in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2022 [<samp>(22481)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/22481062)
  - Count usage from completed v2 compaction rows  -  by @ryoppippi in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2050 [<samp>(b85b2)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/b85b28fb)

###    🏎 Performance

- **claude**: Halve `ccusage claude` report time by skipping redundant JSON work  -  by @ryoppippi in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2058 [<samp>(a06f4)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/a06f4bc7)

#####     [View changes on GitHub](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/compare/v20.0.48...v20.0.49)

hot_issues.title: Feature Request: Accurate Claude Code Usage Tracking Across Multiple Devices
antigravity: missing model names for IDs 1401, 1404, 1427 and 1437
Copilot adapter misses session.usage_record events (daily report returns zero)

discussions.title: ctxtax: cost split by how much context each call sent
claude-carbon: the CO2 of a Claude Code session next to its cost
ccusage is included in the AgentManager tool catalog
subagent-tuner: choose the model and effort of each Claude Code subagent (a cost-control hook)
A hard dollar cap per Claude Code session on API keys (X-Claude-Code-Session-Id + ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS)
WeekToken: will your weekly limit last? Pace for the 5-hour, 7-day and Fable quotas above the Claude Code prompt
OpusBar: Claude Code and Codex plan limits and API value in the macOS menu bar
